route: Official instance-level n8n MCP on n8n Cloud; self-hosted instances are an alternative.

write.delete: General workflow deletion not established in reviewed tool reference; do not substitute unpublish for delete.

setupDetails: On n8n Cloud, an owner/admin enables instance MCP, exposes workflows, then connects the instance URL. Self-hosting adds operational work.

limitations: Enabled workflows are user-scoped, not separately scoped to each connected client. Protected instances block non-read tools except production workflow execution. Building a valid flow does not supply missing credentials.
